episodes.title: Announcing Holy Troublemakers!
episodes.short: Announcing Holy Troublemakers!
episodes.description: Announcing Holy Troublemakers, a new podcast from StarQuest. In this weekly podcast host Dom Bettinelli will introduce you to the difficult people who built the Catholic Church. From mystics who argued with popes to missionaries who walked into places nobody sane would go, every episode tells one of their stories.
